question: E5: what does a paste into the middle of a paragraph do?

inline.html:
On desktop the smallest a row can be is the container width times 0.0215. A PASTED1400px container gives rows of 30.1px. On phones rows start at a fixed 24px.

Row height follows the width, so a layout keeps its proportions when the window changes.
